title: Danqi Chen on "Language Models that Play Chess and Explain Their Moves"
summary: The senior author's one post on the paper, quoting the lead author's thread: a 4B chess language model that plays at typical grandmaster level and explains its moves.

tweets.text:
Super proud of what the team has achieved @AdithyaNLP @jeff_cheng_77  (they are both great researchers and chess players)

A 4B chess LM that plays chess at typical grandmaster level and explains its moves (!)

I will discuss this work at Berkeley in 30 minutes.

Also, I am around this week at @COLM_conf!

quote.text:
The most profound paper of my PhD so far. We truly did something special to make LMs play/explain chess, needing both architectural & algorithmic innovation (natural-language analogue of the Alphazero algorithm) + applicable to many other domains. Please read on and share!

1/10
